# t14.2 — Skill Resilience and Deprecated-Token Warning Remediation

## Summary

Restored the missing `SKL-07` / `RTY-04` execution policy in
`application.skill.ExecuteSkillUseCase` and the `AUTH-10` warning in
`infrastructure.copilot.CopilotService`. The two t14.1 contract classes were not edited:
their five original failures now pass unchanged.

## Implementation

- `ExecuteSkillUseCase` now wraps the outbound `RunCopilotSessionPort` with the existing
  shared `RetryExecutor<SkillResult>` and the skill-domain `SharedCircuitBreaker`.
- The source-anchored policy is preserved: one retry, 500 ms base backoff, 30 s cap, and
  the shared skill circuit breaker.
- Transient exceptions use `RetryPolicyUtils`; permanent authentication failures remain
  single-attempt failures.
- Timeout causes map to a skill-specific `timed out` result, blank responses retain the
  exact `Empty response from Copilot` contract, and an open circuit fails before calling
  the outbound session port.
- `CopilotService.start(String)` is explicitly deprecated-for-removal and emits a static
  WARN before initialization when a token is supplied. The token value is never
  interpolated into the message.

## Layering Conformance

Resilience policy remains in the application use case; the external Copilot call remains
behind its outbound port. The retry mechanism stays in `shared`, circuit state stays in
`domain.resilience`, and the SLF4J deprecation warning stays in the infrastructure adapter.
Full Rule 5 verification inspected 68 application classes with zero adapter dependencies.
